prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star desktop web portfolio comp, first viewport, landscape 16:9
Primary request: Design the first viewport of Costa Maskulov's bilingual creative full-stack developer portfolio in the "Studio Cue" visual world: a live stage-management desk and digital scenography system, translated into a professional web interface.
Scene/backdrop: This must clearly be a real website interface, not a poster or a photograph. Full-bleed responsive desktop viewport with a slim navigation/cue rail, a monumental hero stage, and one clearly interactive project monitor.
Subject and structure: Top navigation contains Costa Maskulov identity, Projets, À propos, FR / EN. The largest region is the hero statement. A second major region is a SideQuest project preview shown inside a graphic stage monitor and explicitly labeled as fictitious. A compact cue strip exposes numbered destinations and status. Primary lime CTA is prominent. Show enough of the next section at the fold to prove this system can continue down the page.
Visual world: theater cue sheets, show-control panels, stage blocking marks, live production labels, modular scenic flats. Cream paper-like base, large decisive violet stage panels, lime reserved for primary action and active cue, pink reserved for editorial annotations, near-black for functional text. Strong visible grid, architectural alignment, active negative space. No literal theater photograph.
Typography: extremely condensed monumental display for short headings, clean highly legible sans-serif for navigation and UI, organic italic serif for one editorial accent only.
Text (verbatim): "COSTA MASKULOV"; "DÉVELOPPEUR FULL-STACK CRÉATIF"; "DES EXPÉRIENCES WEB SINGULIÈRES"; "VOIR LES PROJETS"; "À PROPOS"; "SIDEQUEST"; "MOCK FICTIF — APPLICATION NON RÉALISÉE"; "PROJET 01"; "FR / EN".
Interaction cues: obvious keyboard-focusable controls, visible cue number system, pause-safe motion indicators, no hidden navigation.
Color palette: #F5F1E8 cream, #4B3CFF violet, #C7FF00 lime, #FF6BD6 pink, #101113 near-black.
Materials/textures: subtle printed cue-paper texture and flat scenic-panel color only; crisp production-grade UI.
Constraints: WCAG-minded contrast, readable French copy, no fake client, metrics, code repository, deployment, awards or results. SideQuest must unmistakably read as a mock not a shipped product. Make the portfolio subject visible in every region. One dominant focal move, quieter supporting regions.
Avoid: generic SaaS dashboard, generic developer portfolio cards, neon cyberpunk, gradients, glassmorphism, custom cursor, excessive decoration, photorealistic people, device mockup, poster-only layout, illegible typography, watermark.
